# Summary
Across 300 games (average rating 1701) you scored 48% against 50% expected [F1], and your overall blunder count was close to what the opponent-trained model predicts (0.99 times expected) [F2].

## Biggest weaknesses

**1. Missed discovered attacks (pattern).** In positions where you blundered, the better move was a discovered attack 18 times, versus 4 for your opponents, or 4.50 times their rate [F22]. Example: 29.Bd7 lost 86 win%; the engine preferred Bf5 [F23] (https://www.chess.com/game/live/187005539854).
*Do:* Work through discovered-attack puzzles [F24]. Before each move, check whether moving a piece unmasks a line for a piece behind it.

**2. Queen's Pawn Opening as White (possible weakness).** You scored 27% in 11 games versus 50% expected, a rating-adjusted gap of -4 points with a 90% interval of -15 to +2 [F6]. In moves 13-25 of these games you lost 5.2 win% per move, versus 5.1 across all your games [F12].
*Do:* Review these games and pick a middlegame plan you can repeat after move 12, when the median eval was +0.0 pawns [F12].

**3. Hanging pieces missed (worth watching).** In positions where you blundered, the better move was a hanging piece 28 times, versus 16 for your opponents (1.75 times their rate) [F19]. Example: 43...Kh7 lost 97 win%, and the engine preferred Qxf4+ [F20] (https://www.chess.com/game/live/186801649660). This verdict is tentative because it does not hold after correcting for 18 comparisons [F19].

## What's working
- **Time pressure:** With 10-30% of the clock left you made 60 blunders versus 82.2 expected (0.73 times) [F4].
- **Discovered attacks against you:** Your blunders allowed a discovered attack 6 times, versus 21 for your opponents [F25].

## Training plan
- Practise discovered-attack puzzles: https://lichess.org/training/discoveredAttack [F24].
- Practise hanging-piece puzzles: https://lichess.org/training/hangingPiece [F21]. Before each move, ask which of your pieces is undefended.
- Practise middlegame puzzles: https://lichess.org/training/middlegame [F28]. Your middlegame blunder rate is 6.6% versus 6.2% for opponents [F10].
- Review your Queen's Pawn games as White, focusing on moves 13-25 [F6][F12].
- Check your Englund Gambit as Black, where you scored 21% in 7 games (possible weakness) [F8].
